t: This is a place tied to The Guardian, the British national daily newspaper. It began in Manchester in 1821 as The Manchester Guardian, took the name The Guardian in 1959, and then moved to London. It is owned through the Scott Trust, created in 1936 to secure its financial and editorial independence, and its profits are reinvested in journalism. The founder was John Edward Taylor, a journalist, editor and publisher who started the Manchester Guardian in 1821. It is considered a newspaper of record in the UK.
